description: This Java class defines a test scenario called Scenario3Revoke9, which implements the Scenario3Revoke interface. It sets up a specific authorization test case involving permission revocation on resource '/features' and its subresource '/features/firmware'. The class initializes a scenario setup with parameters indicating granted and revoked permissions and provides access to this setup through the getSetup() method.
